definitions.explanation: An informal, somewhat old-fashioned way to refer to one's husband. Often carries a traditional connotation of the husband as head of the household.
The master or proprietor of an establishment such as an inn or a tea ceremony host. Also used for the host of a tea gathering.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{亭主|ていしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: My husband is good at cooking.

examples.japanese: {亭主|ていしゅ}{関白|かんぱく}な⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: A domineering husband doesn't fit the current era.

examples.japanese: {亭主|ていしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点|た}てた→点てる：13403_tateru⟧。
examples.english: The host carefully prepared the tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{亭主|ていしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The proprietor of the inn welcomed us with a smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{亭主|ていしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三代目|さんだいめ}→三代目：25201_sandaime⟧だそうだ。
examples.english: I hear the owner of this shop is the third generation.

notes:
USAGE:
As "husband," {亭主|ていしゅ} sounds somewhat old-fashioned and informal. It is typically used by wives referring to their own husbands in casual speech. Younger speakers tend to prefer ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧ or ⟦{旦那|だんな}→旦那：12330_danna⟧.

The compound {亭主|ていしゅ}{関白|かんぱく} (lit. "husband regent") describes a domineering husband who expects to be waited on.

As "master/host," {亭主|ていしゅ} is used in tea ceremony (⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧) to refer to the person hosting and serving tea.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {亭主|ていしゅ}{関白|かんぱく}: domineering husband
- うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{亭主|ていしゅ}: my husband (casual)
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{亭主|ていしゅ}: innkeeper
- ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{亭主|ていしゅ}: tea ceremony host
